correctness.rationale: For three named colours, reading successive differences gives ±1 cyclic words of sum M≡0 (mod 3), with exactly three lifts per indexed word. A vertex admits exactly one move when its two neighbours agree, namely when the adjacent signs differ. Thus degree equals the even number of domain walls. At positive degree 2r, marking a positive run gives n choices of its first index and independent positive compositions of the two sign counts into r parts each, with r markings per word. The two constant words are available exactly for 3|n. Marking one movable vertex fixes two opposite signs in two ways; the closure filter on the other n−2 signs has (2^(n−2)+2(−1)^(n−2))/3 completions. Counting lifts and dividing by two proves the edge formula. Two alternating words attain degree n for even n. For odd n=2m+1, n−1 walls force M=±1; at n−3 the two admissible positive counts are m−1 and m+2, giving n m(m+1) colourings for m≥2. At n=3 all six are isolated. If 3 does not divide n, a positive count between 1 and n−1 satisfying closure exists, giving a degree-two word of two runs. All normalization and small cases agree.
residual_risks: The supplied enumeration through n=12 was not rerun; the signed-word proof is unbounded and does not depend on it.

broader_coverage.reasoning: This is broader in the exact controlling parameter M, and the periodic boundary convention includes the last-to-first wall, as does the frozen degree formula. The later asymptotic treatment is not needed.

evidence: With a=N↑ and b=N↓=n−a, equation (30) is C(a−1,r−1)C(b,r)+C(b−1,r−1)C(a,r). Replacing C(j,r) by (j/r)C(j−1,r−1) yields exactly (n/r)C(a−1,r−1)C(b−1,r−1). Summing at M=2a−n≡0 mod 3 and multiplying by three gives the frozen formula identically; equation (26) gives its zero-degree bin. The edge total is its first moment divided by two, and the extremal values and multiplicities follow by reading and specializing the same support.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Only a direct change of variables, a congruence restriction and constant normalization separate the statements. The edge and extremum corollaries are elementary extraction from the already covered count, not independent surviving novelty.

evidence: Periodic Ising spins σ_i are the ternary colour increments. A spin domain wall is a legal single-site recolouring position. Magnetization M is the signed winding numerator and a word lifts iff M≡0 mod 3; there are three lifts.

originality.rationale: The complete degree census is an immediate congruence marginal of the earlier explicit joint periodic Ising count of magnetization and domain walls (Antal–Droz–Rácz, §IV.A, equation (30); equation (26) for zero walls). This is stronger enumerative coverage of precisely the data used by the claim, not merely an abstract encoding or a search resemblance. The translation to recolouring uses successive signed colour increments and three possible initial colours; it does not require a new counting result.
residual_risks: The exact Fourier citation ending 3973681a19d3 was unavailable in the local mirror, and the primary Cereceda et al. full text was not obtained. Neither access limitation drives the verdict; the Ising formulas are explicit, available prior coverage.

value.rationale: The degree spectrum is a natural mobility statistic and a useful recolouring interpretation. But the submitted exact census is a direct normalization and congruence restriction of a known joint exact count. The first moment and extrema are straightforward consequences of that same count; no independently new exact fact with mathematical utility survives the comparison. This is not a rejection of the proof or of the reconfiguration question.
residual_risks: No priority claim is made about the terminology or explicit recolouring presentation. It does not change the exact-count implication.
